items.hed: The Texans host the Colts tonight at NRG Stadium for Thursday Night Football, with Indianapolis already ruling out five starters including cornerback Charvarius Ward and tackle Bernhard Raimann
items.insight: The club's Week 11 injury report shows Indianapolis has ruled out tackle Jalen Travis (knee), tackle Bernhard Raimann (concussion), defensive tackle Jerry Tillery (calf), tight end Will Mallory (hamstring) and cornerback Charvarius Ward (knee) for tonight's game at Houston. Cornerback Sauce Gardner (calf), receiver Anthony Gould (toe), tackle Charlie Heck (personal) and long snapper Luke Rhodes (hamstring) are questionable after limited or no practice participation through Wednesday. Kickoff is tonight at NRG Stadium.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium, Houston, Feb. 5, 2017. Venue still.

items.hed: The Astros brought back Brad Ausmus as their next manager, naming the former Houston catcher and longtime Yankees bench coach to lead the club
items.insight: Ausmus, a longtime catcher who spent the last three years as the New York Yankees' bench coach, was named the Astros' next manager, the team announced last Wednesday, according to MLB.com. 'I'm very excited to be back with Houston,' Ausmus said at his introductory news conference. Ausmus and Hall of Famer Jeff Bagwell, one of owner Jim Crane's closest confidants, played together on the Astros from 1997-98 and 2001-05 and started together on the club's first World Series team.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: Houston closed out its three-game road trip with a 119-104 win at Indiana, improving to 12-4 on the season before a rematch at Denver on Friday
items.insight: The Rockets beat the Pacers 119-104 on Wednesday night to close a trip that also included a win at Washington and a loss at Miami, improving Houston's record to 12-4 through games of Nov. 19, according to the team's official schedule. The Rockets' next game is Friday at Denver, tipping off at 11 p.m. ET.
